_what: Paradox sync completion witness for the LoadFirst (option B) sitting leg D and its unattended rehearsal: wraps the tasks pushed on this process's g_PopsDownloadModsQueue so the log carries the sync root, every child it scheduled, each start/return/error and any Clear, and reports a verdict that is COMPLETE only when all of them returned without error or cancellation; queue length is diagnostic only. MODE unattended waits for the boot-time attempt to settle, logs the verdict and saved order and quits; MODE sitting binds the SMRTK scratch slot Sync read and never quits. Edit MODE in the parked payload before each arm. Reads only: no mod-list helper, no persistent data, no save.
mustNotBeListedWhy: The autorun would start a colony and race the menu; forced-inactive changes the pack statuses read beside the verdict; the read, set and pack payloads also quit at the menu and would race this one in MODE unattended.
